exposure: Obstetrician's opinion on non-medically indicated cesarean sections (CS)
Obstetrician's experience with lawsuits related to CS
Obstetrician's willingness to perform CS on request (CSor)
outcome: Factors influencing obstetricians' decisions regarding CS
finding: The surge in CSor rates was mostly correlated with an attempt to escape the fear of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: This survey study found that the increase in cesarean sections on request is primarily driven by a desire to avoid the perceived risks of vaginal delivery.
